$comment: External executables this setup depends on. CORRECTED 2026-09-20 against a live cloud session: `cloudPreinstalled` now records what `command -v` returned in that session, not what the documentation lists. Earlier revisions of this file were wrong twice in opposite directions - once claiming ripgrep and uv were absent when they are present, once claiming gh is present when it is not.
$tiers: core = the toolkit cannot work without it. feature = an optional flag or a nicety degrades without it. reference = recorded because it exists on the maintainer's machine or in a cloud image; NOTHING here depends on it, so its absence is never a failure. local/doctor.sh FAILs only on core.

verifiedAgainst.source: command -v run in a live Claude Code cloud session

supersedes.note: The documentation list was taken as the fact. It is right about every entry here except gh.

git.neededFor: Everything. The toolkit is a git checkout.

jq.neededFor: local/bootstrap.sh and local/doctor.sh read the manifests with it. Absent, they degrade rather than fail. Also a hard dependency of the rtk PreToolUse hook (local only).

node.neededFor: NOTHING IN THIS TOOLKIT. Recorded because the machine-local hooks in local/settings.fragment.json invoke it. Cloud ships 20, 21 and 22; 22 on PATH. Local observed 24.21.0.

python3.neededFor: tools/check.py and tools/vendor-sync.py. Requires 3.9+, stdlib only.

rg.neededFor: NOTHING IN THIS TOOLKIT. Recorded as cloud-preinstalled reference data only.

gh.neededFor: NOTHING IN THIS TOOLKIT. Recorded as reference data, and as a warning: see the note.
gh.note: MEASURED 2026-09-20 in a cloud session: `command -v gh` and `command -v hub` both return nothing and nothing gh-shaped is anywhere on PATH, though the official installed-tools list names gh. This file declared it present, and that declaration cost a real round trip when a plan was written around `gh repo create`. Do not write one. In a cloud session use the GitHub MCP tools (mcp__github__*) or plain git, which authenticates through the proxy by credential injection. Locally gh is present and authenticates normally.

uv.neededFor: NOTHING IN THIS TOOLKIT. Recorded as cloud-preinstalled reference data only.

rtk.purpose: Token-reducing CLI proxy; invoked by a PreToolUse Bash hook on every command.
rtk.WARNING: Do NOT run 'cargo install rtk'. The crates.io crate named 'rtk' is a DIFFERENT project (reachingforthejack/rtk, 'Rust Type Kit'). Installing it replaces the working binary with one that has no 'rewrite' subcommand and silently disables the PreToolUse hook on every Bash call.

srt.purpose: Anthropic Sandbox Runtime. The OS-enforced boundary claude-safe runs Claude Code inside.
srt.reason: Cloud sessions use Anthropic's own per-session VM isolation. This is a separate, non-equivalent boundary and must not be assumed to carry over.

bwrap.purpose: bubblewrap; the kernel-namespace primitive srt builds on.

claude-safe.RISK: Has no git remote as of 2026-09-19. The hardened launcher, its threat model and its six test suites exist on exactly one disk.
